subject: Kosambi mapping taking a long time

messages.author: fb92e83924bbcbf6
messages.subject: Kosambi mapping taking a long time
parts:
I am trying to estimate a genetic map for a cross using the est.map()
function, map.function="kosambi" for about 12,000 markers (across 12
chromosomes). I am using a computer with 10GB RAM allocated to R, with
n.cluster set to 10, yet the process seems to be taking a very long
time. Is this normal for estimating a map with so many markers, or is
there another reason why it should be so slow?
Thanks, I appreciate any input on this.

-Jen

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Kosambi mapping taking a long time
parts:
Yes, it can take a very long time.

Using n.cluster will distribute the map estimation of individual chromosomes to the multiple CPUs, but doesn't help to speed up the calculations on a given chromosome.

I will often consider a single selected chromosome and use the argument verbose=2 so that I can monitor convergence. If you make the argument 'tol' a larger number (say 0.01), it will halt earlier (though with less precise estimates).

karl
